Laura / Marcus — my read from interviewing and the summary: technically capable with strong ML research/infra intuition but not the immediate production-hit we need for the 927 scope (serving high-throughput generative models). Two gating items for me: 1) comp band overstep (ask > posted band by ~$30k) and 2) headcount prioritization — executive ask is to prioritize infra hires that reduce unit cost this quarter. - close this req and re-open with a more senior band if we decide to prioritize speed of hire, or
- keep the req frozen until H2 headcount refresh.

If the committee prefers to proceed with an exception, we will need VP approval + updated headcount allocation from Priyom and a justification doc. Please share final votes by EOD Tues so I can get back to Jane.
